quotes.text: “If Thou Wilt Enter into Life, Keep the Commandments” By Elder Robert D. Hales Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles The Savior said, “If thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments” ( Matt. 19:17 ). I would like to tell you a story, brethren—a true story about a man named Abinadi. Abinadi was a prophet who preached repentance to a wicked people and a wicked king. He preached boldly and…

quotes.text: King Noah caused Alma to be cast out, and sent his servants after him for to slay him, because he pleaded for the prophet Abinadi. But Alma escaped. Page 179.
